method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Equities: US stock rally broadens as S&P 500 hits new high – Deutsche Bank
Equities.summary: Deutsche Bank strategists report that United States (US) equities, led by the S&P 500, have reached new record highs as softer inflation data and lower Oil prices reinforce expectations that the Fed can stay on hold.
Equities.reason: Clear, high‑impact market regimen: soft inflation + lower oil = Fed hold narrative driving broad S&P record highs. Strongly bullish for equities and market regime, high relevance as a macro driver.

Equities.title: S&P 500 notches record-high close as rate-hike worries ease
Equities.reason: Reinforces the dominant narrative that fading rate‑hike bets and cooler inflation are underpinning broad equity gains; meaningful market‑wide confirmation, high relevance.

Equities.title: These charts show why stocks keep rallying. Profit margins are the highest on record
Equities.summary: Recent FactSet data show that the rise in earnings is not coming from sales growth alone.
Equities.reason: Fundamental support for the rally: record profit margins bolster earnings narrative and justify risk appetite—positive for equities but more fundamental/medium relevance than top macro datapoints.

Equities.title: An inside look at SK Hynix $720 billion AI-fueled buildout that's taking over South Korea
Equities.summary: SK Hynix, the leading maker of high-bandwidth memory, is pouring $720 billion into memory factories to meet AI demand. We got an exclusive first look.
Equities.reason: Major structural/sectoral driver: massive AI capex by memory supplier supports tech leadership and capex‑driven equity flows—material for sector leadership and overall market sentiment.

Equities.title: AI frenzy drives Chinese tech valuations to multiples of US peers
Equities.summary: Support from Beijing has helped power 29% gain for Star 50 index this year
Equities.reason: Highlights how AI‑led narratives are powering international equity rallies (China tech) and fueling valuations—positive for risk appetite but flags concentration/froth risk (moderate relevance).

Equities.title: Asian stocks head for strong weekly gains as US rate hike bets fade
Equities.reason: Cross‑regional confirmation of the same macro regime: fading US rate‑hike expectations are lifting Asian equities, reinforcing global risk‑on bias and breadth of the rally.

Rates.title: US Dollar: Carry trades supported as Fed seen on hold – OCBC
Rates.summary: OCBC’s Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong note that softer United States (US) Producer Price Index (PPI) and lower US Treasury yields have led markets to scale back expectations of a September Federal Reserve (Fed) hike, limiting US Dollar (USD) upside.
Rates.reason: Article explicitly notes lower US Treasury yields and reduced Fed hike odds — a clear bond-positive signal (yields down). High relevance because it signals a shift in Fed expectations and Treasury market direction.

Rates.title: US Dollar: Softer tone with falling yields – MUFG
Rates.summary: MUFG’s Lee Hardman notes the US Dollar (USD) is trading on a softer footing as Federal Reserve (Fed) rate hike expectations are scaled back following weaker labour data and a mixed United States (US) Producer Price Index (PPI) report.
Rates.reason: Direct reference to falling yields and scaled-back Fed hike expectations — reinforces a bond-friendly narrative (lower yields). Good relevance as it comes from a major FX/FX-rate strategist linking macro prints to Treasury yields.

Rates.title: Canadian Dollar gathers strength on easing Fed rate hike bets
Rates.summary: The USD/CAD pair attracts some sellers to around 1.3910 during the early European trading hours on Friday. The US Dollar (USD) weakens against the Canadian Dollar (CAD) as cooled US inflation data have tempered aggressive Federal Reserve (Fed) rate-hike bets.
Rates.reason: FX piece but explicitly links cooled US inflation and tempered Fed bets to USD weakness via lower US yield expectations — supports a modestly positive bond-price view (yields down). Relevance moderated because primary focus is FX.

Rates.title: AI-driven surge in bond yields could be next risk for markets and growth
Rates.reason: Headline flags a macro risk of a material rise in bond yields driven by AI-related dynamics — explicit bearish shock to bond prices (yields up). High relevance as this is a broad market/regime-level risk narrative that could drive yields higher across markets.

Rates.title: PBOC’s First Mid-Month Overnight Reverse Repo Boosts Bonds
Rates.reason: PBOC conducting an intra-month reverse repo is a liquidity injection that directly supports local bond prices (yields down). Relevant for Rates because central-bank money-market operations change term-structure and risk premia.

Rates.title: Why Speculative Investors Are Betting on RBA Rate Hike in November
Rates.reason: Stories about growing market bets for an RBA hike imply higher Australian yields ahead (local bond-negative). Regional central-bank tightening expectations have modest relevance to global rates and risk sentiment.

Rates.title: AI’s infrastructure boom is getting more leveraged — and harder to track
Rates.summary: AI’s infrastructure boom is increasingly being funded through bonds, leases and private capital, while leveraged investors add another layer of market risk.
Rates.reason: Notes rising bond-financed leverage for AI infrastructure and the build-up of financing risk — a negative for bond markets if deleveraging or higher risk premia occur (upward pressure on yields). Relevant as it highlights a structural source of rate volatility.

Rates.title: Mortgage rates fall for first time in 6 weeks
Rates.reason: Reports a near-term decline in mortgage rates — modestly supportive of lower yields and bond prices rally in the consumer/mortgage segment. Lower relevance because this is secondary to sovereign market rates.

Rates.title: African Domestic Debt Outshines EM Peers as High-Yield Chase Intensifies
Rates.reason: Describes investor demand chasing higher-yielding African domestic debt — supports tighter yields/stronger prices in those markets and signals cross-border flows into EM credit. Relevant to Rates as it reflects demand-side effects on yields, but limited global impact.

Rates.title: Norwegian Krone: Weaker after Norges Bank holds rates – Danske Bank
Rates.summary: Danske Research Team notes that Norges Bank left its policy rate at 4.25% and kept a tightening bias despite weaker summer inflation. They still expect one final hike in September, though the odds have fallen and the decision is now finely balanced.
Rates.reason: Norges Bank holding but retaining a tightening bias suggests potential for higher short-term Norwegian yields (local bond-negative). Relevant to Rates for regional rate-path expectations and term-premium implications.

FX.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Hawkish ECB prospects support Euro
FX.summary: The Euro (EUR) trades 0.17% higher at around 1.1550 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Friday. The major currency pair gains as the Euro rises due to firm expectations that the European Central Bank (ECB) will raise interest rat
FX.reason: ECB hawkish prospects are a direct, high‑signal driver for EUR/USD; supports Euro vs USD and reinforces the broader USD‑weakness narrative.

FX.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: Picks up above 1.3500 amid generalised US Dollar weakness
FX.summary: The British Pound (GBP) pares losses against a weaker US Dollar (USD) on Friday, as a run of soft US inflation figures and growing signs of labour market deterioration have cast doubt about the odds for an immediate Federal Reserve (Fed) rate hike.
FX.reason: GBP strength is being driven by broad USD weakness (weaker Fed hike odds); relevant for major‑pair flows and the USD‑centric view.

FX.title: British Pound: Growth resilience supports gains against US Dollar – MUFG
FX.summary: MUFG’s Lee Hardman reports the British Pound (GBP) is the best performing major currency in August, with GBP/USD back above 1.3500. The United Kingdom (UK) economy is proving resilient to the energy price shock linked to the US-Iran conflict, with Q2 GDP up 0.
FX.reason: Fundamental UK growth resilience supports GBP/USD beyond transitory USD moves; medium relevance as it reinforces the GBP outperformer narrative.

FX.title: US Dollar Index Price Forecast: DXY declines to 99.75-99.70 amid receding Fed hike bets
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the Greenback against a basket of currencies, continues to lose ground through the first half of the European session on Friday and retreats further from a two-week high, touched the previous day.
FX.reason: Direct DXY decline is a high‑signal USD weakness impulse (receding Fed hike bets) that supports majors across the board; central to FX regime today.

FX.title: Forex Today: Easing Fed rate hike bets weigh on USD amid Mideast stalemate
FX.summary: Here is what you need to know on Friday, August 14:
FX.reason: Concise thematic note: easing Fed bets + geopolitical risk = USD weakness narrative driving broad FX moves; useful for cross‑market context.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: BoJ tightening debate supports JPY – Rabobank
FX.summary: Rabobank strategist Elwin de Groot highlights that Japanese policymakers are increasingly focused on achieving the inflation target sustainably and supporting the Japanese Yen. Following recent FX intervention, He argues that exchange-rate management ultimatel
FX.reason: BoJ tightness debate and recent intervention talk are direct support for JPY vs USD; material to FX given policy/intervention transmission.

FX.title: Japan may see more yen intervention, faster BOJ rate hikes, ex-top FX diplomat says
FX.reason: Reuters piece flags renewed risk of official yen intervention and faster BoJ normalisation — high‑impact for USD/JPY and global FX flows; elevated relevance.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar hits fresh high since June on rising oil prices, Fed-inspired USD weakness
FX.summary: The USD/CAD pair extends the previous day's decline from the top end of the weekly range and attracts follow-through selling for the second straight day.
FX.reason: CAD strength is tied to higher oil and USD weakness — a clear commodity‑FX transmission relevant for USD/CAD flows.

FX.title: Australian Dollar: Upside risk intact above support against US Dollar – UOB
FX.summary: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann note AUD/USD is consolidating intraday between 0.7050 and 0.7075 after a brief spike to 0.7091 failed to build momentum.
FX.reason: Technical/strategic note that AUD retains upside vs USD, supported by hawkish RBA commentary; relevance limited by technical focus.

FX.title: US Dollar: Labor slowdown gives mixed signals for Dollar - Commerzbank
FX.summary: Commerzbank’s Volkmar Baur and Tatha Ghose highlight that despite a “low-hire, low-fire” US labor market, the Dollar remains supported. Initial jobless claims and unemployment stay very low, while wage growth shows only tentative signs of slowing.
FX.reason: Bank note flags persistent underlying support for the USD despite some soft labour signals — a counter‑narrative that reduces the unilateral USD‑weakness case.

Commodities.title: Gold heads for weekly loss as investors unwind inflation-fuelled rally
Commodities.reason: Gold selling as investors take profits and unwind an inflation-driven rally is a near-term bearish impulse for the bullion market. Medium relevance—metal-specific but not signalling a structural regime shift.

Commodities.title: Gold recovers intraday losses as reduced Fed hike bets offset geopolitics and weigh on USD
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) finds decent support ahead of the $4,300 mark and recovers a major part of its intraday losses during the first half of the European session on Friday.
Commodities.reason: Reduced Fed-hike expectations and a softer USD provide support for gold; intraday/technical focus limits relevance under the scoring rules but still supportive for bullion.

Commodities.title: Brent: Geopolitical premium eases after six-day rally – Deutsche Bank
Commodities.summary: Deutsche Bank analysts highlight that Brent Oil has finally broken a six-day winning streak, with prices pulling back modestly as some geopolitical risk premium is removed.
Commodities.reason: Analyst view that the geopolitical risk premium is retracting is a clear bearish signal for Brent near-term prices; relevant because it reflects a macro drivers update rather than idiosyncratic noise.

Commodities.title: Tankers Are Going Dark for Longer to Get Oil Out of Middle East
Commodities.reason: Reports that tankers are using tactics to move Middle Eastern oil more effectively imply rising physical flows into markets, which is bearish for oil prices and materially relevant to supply-side dynamics.

Commodities.title: Oil rises after US threatens indefinite blockade of Iran; set for weekly gains
Commodities.reason: A U.S. threat to blockade Iran is a material geopolitical supply shock risk that supports higher oil prices; high relevance because it directly affects perceived physical supply disruption.

Commodities.title: An Influx of Middle Eastern Oil Is Finally Hitting American Shores
Commodities.reason: Evidence of increased Middle Eastern crude arrivals into the U.S. increases supply availability and works to lower the oil risk premium; relevant as a physical-flow datapoint countering geopolitical headlines.

Commodities.title: Trump-linked oil venture delays Greenland drilling plans after government warning
Commodities.summary: Greenland Energy Co. and joint venture partner 80 Mile have delayed planned oil drilling in Greenland until winter 2027.
Commodities.reason: A delay in drilling reduces prospective future supply growth (small near-term impact), modestly supportive for oil prices but limited relevance to global balances.

Commodities.title: United States on track for record natural gas production in 2026
Commodities.summary: We forecast U.S. marketed natural gas production will average 122.5 billion cubic feet per day (Bcf/d) in 2026, surpassing the previous record of 118.5 Bcf/d set in 2025, in our August 2026 Short-Term Energy Outlook (STEO).
Commodities.reason: EIA forecast for record U.S. gas production is a structurally bearish supply signal for natural gas prices and is highly relevant as an authoritative production outlook.

Commodities.title: How a niche copper trade became a real-time gauge of Trump’s next tariff move
Commodities.summary: The widening price of copper between two metals exchanges is offering investors a gauge of U.S. tariff risk.
Commodities.reason: Widening exchange spreads as a gauge of tariff risk point to elevated policy-driven uncertainty and potential demand downside for copper; relevant to the metal but not a direct supply/demand shock.

Commodities.title: Tyson to Close More Beef Plants as US Cattle Shortage Drags On
Commodities.reason: Plant closures amid a cattle shortage tighten beef supply and are supportive for live cattle prices; relevant because it signals a material supply-side constraint in a covered livestock commodity.

Crypto.title: SEC Delays Crypto Regulation Meeting in Latest Industry Setback
Crypto.reason: Broad US regulatory delay is a material negative for crypto markets — slows rule clarity, product approvals and institutional flows. High relevance because it affects industry-wide policy and market access.

Crypto.title: SEC cancels long-awaited proposal of Reg Crypto, postponing meeting without new date
Crypto.reason: Cancellation of a major regulatory proposal reinforces policy uncertainty for exchanges, tokens and institutional entrants — negative for sentiment and product rollout timing.

Crypto.title: U.S. SEC to again delay 'innovation exemption' for tokenization amid Wall Street, White House concerns
Crypto.reason: Delay to a tokenization-specific exemption directly slows institutional use-cases (securities tokenization, asset-backed tokens) — a negative for on‑chain capital markets adoption.

Crypto.title: Tether says it completed long-promised 'Big Four' audit of finances behind $180 billion USDT stablecoin
Crypto.reason: Completion of a major audit for USDT reduces a core counterparty uncertainty for crypto markets and supports stablecoin trust/liquidity — positive for market plumbing and on‑chain flows.

Crypto.title: Cluster of headwinds weigh on bitcoin. XRP teeters near $1
Crypto.reason: Market-level negative momentum and multiple pressures on BTC/XRP signal weaker price action and sentiment; relevant for short-term market direction and trader flows.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin holders Strategy and Metaplanet face stock-index exclusion under MSCI’s new proposal
Crypto.reason: Potential index exclusion for firms holding large BTC positions could pressure listing liquidity and investor demand for these equities, indirectly affecting market sentiment around concentrated BTC holders.

Crypto.title: Trezor warns 14,000 customers after fulfilment partner suffers data breach
Crypto.reason: Custody/consumer security breach undermines user trust and onboarding for hardware wallets — a localized but material negative for security-sensitive adoption channels.

Crypto.title: Figure revenue doubles as blockchain loan marketplace volumes surge
Crypto.reason: Growth in DeFi/crypto lending volumes and revenue signals ongoing real-economy use of blockchain credit infrastructure — supportive for ecosystem adoption and on‑chain activity.

Crypto.title: JPMorgan shuttered its banking relationship with predictions platform Polymarket: FT
Crypto.reason: Loss of a major banking relationship highlights ongoing friction between crypto businesses and traditional banks — negative for fiat on/off-ramps and operational stability.

Crypto.title: Brazil’s largest bitcoin treasury firm plans ETF with 95% allocation to Strategy's STRC
Crypto.reason: Launch of a large ETF product (Brazil) with concentrated BTC-linked allocation supports productization and institutional demand in regional markets — modestly positive for flows.
